decision_rule: Exclude only when current official evidence establishes that ordinary public access is unavailable; public only when official evidence shows customers can reach the exact outlet without relying on a member to sign them in/accompany them. Tenant listings, hours, member discounts, historical vendor lists, or SFA licensing do not alone prove access.
limitations: SAFRA By-Laws §6.4 is conditional (“where applicable”), not a blanket statement that all clubhouses or F&B tenants are members-only.
For 10 of 11 records, current official sources found confirm the tenant or outlet data but do not expressly settle nonmember route/access. These remain unresolved rather than being removed.
